entity.name: Morad Othmane
entity.description: Designer and developer building open-source Arabic / right-to-left (RTL) internationalization tooling under OttoSpace. Author of Miraat, Lahja, Kashida, Daleel and Mizan — a suite that helps teams ship correct, high-quality bilingual and RTL interfaces.

projects.name: Miraat
projects.description: An RTL (right-to-left) linter for the web. Miraat statically analyzes markup and CSS to catch bidirectional-text and RTL layout bugs before they ship, so Arabic, Hebrew and Persian interfaces render correctly.

projects.name: Lahja
projects.description: An i18n linter that flags missing, malformed, and inconsistent translation strings across locale files, keeping bilingual and multilingual apps correct as they grow.

projects.name: Kashida
projects.description: An Arabic text-shaping and justification tool built on HarfBuzz, handling kashida elongation and correct RTL letterform joining for typographically faithful Arabic layout.

projects.name: Daleel
projects.description: A compliance checker for Saudi Digital Government Authority (DGA) design and accessibility guidelines, helping teams meet KSA public-sector digital standards.

projects.name: Mizan
projects.description: A benchmark suite that measures how well AI models and tools handle Arabic and right-to-left content, scoring correctness of generated RTL layouts and text.

plans.name: Support ongoing development
plans.description: Fund continued development, maintenance and documentation of the OttoSpace RTL tooling suite.

plans.name: One-time grant
plans.description: One-time grant funding to accelerate roadmap items: CI actions, editor integrations and expanded RTL rule coverage.
